title: basecoat: Core volume container, region-lazy I/O, and coordinate transforms for the BASE Lab ecosystem
description: Foundational volumetric container, OME-Zarr v0.4 / HDF5 / TIFF / raw region-lazy I/O, pullback 3D coordinate transforms, cell-centred resampling, and SHA-256 dataset fetching for the BASE Laboratory image-based modelling ecosystem.
